newsitem.title: SPAIN: DIVING-WELS WINS FIRST GOLD OF EURO CHAMPIONSHIPS.
newsitem.headline: DIVING-WELS WINS FIRST GOLD OF EURO CHAMPIONSHIPS.

text.p: Germany's Andreas Wels claimed the first gold medal of the European swimming championships when he won the men's one-metre springboard diving title on Thursday.
Wels led a German one-two with Holger Schlepps, who overhauled Spaniard Rafael Alvarez to clinch the silver medal with an excellent final dive.
Wels, fourth at the last European championships in Vienna in 1995, compiled 362.10 points from his six final dives beneath a scorching sun at the San Pablo pool.
Schlepps took the silver with 357.12 points and Alvarez, who had beaten Schlepps in winning his morning semifinal, had to settle for bronze with 355.56.
Confusion was caused by the failure of the electronic scoring system on the opening dive of the final and intermittently during the first three rounds of dives.
